LanguageData.ageless_age_tick_factor_desc: Multiplier for the amount by which a pawn (biologically) ages per tick.
LanguageData.ageless_age_tick_factor_editor_info: -> As this is for becoming ageless, you cannot go above a multipler of 1.
LanguageData.ageless_gene_desc: Carriers of this gene have archites in the bloodstream which continuously reverse the process of aging. Starting at the age of {0}, carriers begin to biologically age slower. By {1}, the aging process stops completely.
